source.title: Graph Engineering with Claude Code: Anthropic's Agent Graph

chunks.topic: What graph engineering with Claude means; mapping nodes/edges/shared state onto subagents/orchestrator routing/returned results; the three primitives (.claude/agents/ subagents, hooks as deterministic edges, the Claude Agent SDK) and the hand-roll-then-lift ordering; Anthropic's orchestrator-workers system as proof (90.2% improvement, 15x token cost, over-spawn failure mode)

Step-by-step guide to wiring a first agent graph (pick a splittable job, one subagent per node, orchestrator routing, fan-out/fan-in, hooks for untrustworthy edges); when NOT to reach for a graph; Related Content links; FAQ; Sources & Verification
